sys_ui_page.html:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8" ?>
<j:jelly trim="false" xmlns:j="jelly:core" xmlns:g="glide">
  <g:evaluate var="jvar_html" jelly="true">
    var html = '';
    var gr = new GlideRecord('x_168647_aiva_request');
  if (gr.get(RP.getParameterValue('sysparm_sys_id'))) {
      html = gr.getValue('proposed_architecture') || '';

      // strip markdown fences if the AI added them
      html = html.replace(/^\s*```(?:html)?\s*/i, '').replace(/\s*```\s*$/, '');

      // convert HTML-only entities  (paste it here)
      html = html.replace(/&mdash;/g, '—')
                 .replace(/&nbsp;/g, ' ')
                 .replace(/&rarr;/g, '→')
                 .replace(/&bull;/g, '•');
    }
    html;
  </g:evaluate>
  <html>
    <head><meta charset="UTF-8"/></head>
    <body><g:no_escape>${jvar_html}</g:no_escape></body>
  </html>
</j:jelly>
sys_ui_page.name: prop_ark
